The [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] '''Missile Trooper''' was a specialized soldier who carried a [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]]. The troopers could also become '''Armored Missile Troopers''' and carry two launchers.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Missile Troopers appear in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
